p01_neg_start.ll.source:
; Negative starting index counting up to 0: p[-10..-1], inbounds.
define void @neg_start(ptr %p, i8 %v) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %i = phi i16 [ -10, %entry ], [ %i1, %loop ]
  %a = getelementptr inbounds i8, ptr %p, i16 %i
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %a, align 1
  %i1 = add nsw i16 %i, 1
  %c = icmp eq i16 %i1, 0
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  ret void
}

p02_unflagged_nuw_iv.ll.source:
; Unflagged GEP with an add-nuw index IV. The address may wrap in a
; well-defined execution (p = 0xFFF0), so nuw must not be added.
define void @unflagged_nuw_iv(ptr %p, i8 %v) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %i = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %i1, %loop ]
  %a = getelementptr i8, ptr %p, i16 %i
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %a, align 1
  %i1 = add nuw nsw i16 %i, 1
  %c = icmp eq i16 %i1, 64
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  ret void
}
; Same with a nuw-flagged i8 IV zero-extended.
define void @unflagged_zext_iv(ptr %p, i8 %v) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %j = phi i8 [ 0, %entry ], [ %j1, %loop ]
  %z = zext i8 %j to i16
  %a = getelementptr i8, ptr %p, i16 %z
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %a, align 1
  %j1 = add nuw i8 %j, 1
  %c = icmp eq i8 %j1, 200
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  ret void
}

p04_nested.ll.source:
; Outer recurrence used inside the inner loop, plus a row pointer.
define void @nested(ptr %p, i8 %v) {
entry:
  br label %outer
outer:
  %i = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %i1, %olatch ]
  %row = shl nuw nsw i16 %i, 4
  %rp = getelementptr inbounds i8, ptr %p, i16 %row
  br label %inner
inner:
  %j = phi i16 [ 0, %outer ], [ %j1, %inner ]
  %a = getelementptr inbounds i8, ptr %rp, i16 %j
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %a, align 1
  %b = getelementptr inbounds i8, ptr %p, i16 %i
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %b, align 1
  %j1 = add nuw nsw i16 %j, 1
  %jc = icmp eq i16 %j1, 16
  br i1 %jc, label %olatch, label %inner
olatch:
  %i1 = add nuw nsw i16 %i, 1
  %ic = icmp eq i16 %i1, 8
  br i1 %ic, label %exit, label %outer
exit:
  ret void
}
; Outer recurrence unflagged, used inside inner loop: may wrap -> no nuw.
define void @nested_unflagged(ptr %p, i8 %v) {
entry:
  br label %outer
outer:
  %i = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %i1, %olatch ]
  br label %inner
inner:
  %j = phi i16 [ 0, %outer ], [ %j1, %inner ]
  %s = add i16 %i, %j
  %a = getelementptr i8, ptr %p, i16 %s
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %a, align 1
  %j1 = add nuw nsw i16 %j, 1
  %jc = icmp eq i16 %j1, 16
  br i1 %jc, label %olatch, label %inner
olatch:
  %i1 = add nuw nsw i16 %i, 16
  %ic = icmp eq i16 %i1, 128
  br i1 %ic, label %exit, label %outer
exit:
  ret void
}

p05_conditional.ll.source:
; Inbounds address used only on a conditional path: SCEV must not treat
; its poison as UB for every iteration.
define void @conditional(ptr %p, ptr %q, i8 %v) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %i = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %i1, %latch ]
  %qa = getelementptr inbounds i8, ptr %q, i16 %i
  %f = load volatile i8, ptr %qa, align 1
  %t = icmp ne i8 %f, 0
  br i1 %t, label %then, label %latch
then:
  %a = getelementptr inbounds i8, ptr %p, i16 %i
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %a, align 1
  br label %latch
latch:
  %i1 = add nuw nsw i16 %i, 1
  %c = icmp eq i16 %i1, 64
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  ret void
}
; Unflagged address used every iteration, flagged one only conditionally.
define void @conditional_only_flag(ptr %p, i8 %v, i1 %k) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %i = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %i1, %latch ]
  %u = getelementptr i8, ptr %p, i16 %i
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %u, align 1
  br i1 %k, label %then, label %latch
then:
  %a = getelementptr inbounds i8, ptr %p, i16 %i
  %w = load volatile i8, ptr %a, align 1
  br label %latch
latch:
  %i1 = add nuw nsw i16 %i, 1
  %c = icmp eq i16 %i1, 64
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  ret void
}
; Early exit before the inbounds access in the latch.
define void @early_exit(ptr %p, ptr %q, i8 %v) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %i = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %i1, %latch ]
  %u = getelementptr i8, ptr %p, i16 %i
  %f = load volatile i8, ptr %q, align 1
  %t = icmp eq i8 %f, 0
  br i1 %t, label %exit, label %latch
latch:
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %u, align 1
  %a = getelementptr inbounds i8, ptr %p, i16 %i
  %w = load volatile i8, ptr %a, align 1
  %i1 = add nuw nsw i16 %i, 1
  %c = icmp eq i16 %i1, 64
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  ret void
}

p06_offset_base.ll.source:
; p[j+5]: LSR may hoist p+5 as the GEP base.
define void @offset_pos(ptr %p, i8 %v) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %j = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %j1, %loop ]
  %k = add nuw nsw i16 %j, 5
  %a = getelementptr inbounds i8, ptr %p, i16 %k
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %a, align 1
  %j1 = add nuw nsw i16 %j, 1
  %c = icmp eq i16 %j1, 64
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  ret void
}
; p[j-5], j = 0..63: indices -5..58, inbounds; base may be p-5.
define void @offset_neg(ptr %p, i8 %v) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %j = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %j1, %loop ]
  %k = add nsw i16 %j, -5
  %a = getelementptr inbounds i8, ptr %p, i16 %k
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %a, align 1
  %j1 = add nuw nsw i16 %j, 1
  %c = icmp eq i16 %j1, 64
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  ret void
}
; Two accesses p[j] (unflagged) and p[j+1] (inbounds).
define void @mixed_pair(ptr %p, i8 %v) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %j = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %j1, %loop ]
  %a = getelementptr i8, ptr %p, i16 %j
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %a, align 1
  %k = add nuw nsw i16 %j, 1
  %b = getelementptr inbounds i8, ptr %p, i16 %k
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %b, align 1
  %j1 = add nuw nsw i16 %j, 1
  %c = icmp eq i16 %j1, 64
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  ret void
}

p07_elem_types.ll.source:
; Non-i8 element types.
define void @elem_i16(ptr %p, i16 %v) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %j = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %j1, %loop ]
  %a = getelementptr inbounds i16, ptr %p, i16 %j
  store volatile i16 %v, ptr %a, align 1
  %j1 = add nuw nsw i16 %j, 1
  %c = icmp eq i16 %j1, 32
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  ret void
}
%S = type { i8, i8, i8 }
define void @elem_struct(ptr %p, i8 %v) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %j = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %j1, %loop ]
  %a = getelementptr inbounds %S, ptr %p, i16 %j, i32 2
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %a, align 1
  %j1 = add nuw nsw i16 %j, 1
  %c = icmp eq i16 %j1, 20
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  ret void
}
; A non-IV i16 index into an i16 array survives LSR untouched.
define void @elem_i16_loaded(ptr %p, ptr %idx, i16 %v) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %j = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %j1, %loop ]
  %ia = getelementptr inbounds i8, ptr %idx, i16 %j
  %x = load volatile i8, ptr %ia, align 1
  %xz = zext i8 %x to i16
  %a = getelementptr inbounds i16, ptr %p, i16 %xz
  store volatile i16 %v, ptr %a, align 1
  %j1 = add nuw nsw i16 %j, 1
  %c = icmp eq i16 %j1, 32
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  ret void
}

p09_addrspace1.ll.source:
; Zero-page (addrspace(1), 8-bit pointer) addresses are out of scope.
define void @zp(ptr addrspace(1) %p, i8 %v) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %j = phi i8 [ 0, %entry ], [ %j1, %loop ]
  %a = getelementptr inbounds i8, ptr addrspace(1) %p, i8 %j
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr addrspace(1) %a, align 1
  %j1 = add nuw nsw i8 %j, 1
  %c = icmp eq i8 %j1, 16
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  ret void
}

p10_vector.ll.source:
; Vector GEP inside a loop (stop-after only).
define void @vec(<2 x ptr> %p, ptr %out) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %j = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %j1, %loop ]
  %ins = insertelement <2 x i16> poison, i16 %j, i32 0
  %spl = shufflevector <2 x i16> %ins, <2 x i16> poison, <2 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %a = getelementptr inbounds i8, <2 x ptr> %p, <2 x i16> %spl
  %e = extractelement <2 x ptr> %a, i32 0
  store volatile ptr %e, ptr %out, align 1
  %j1 = add nuw nsw i16 %j, 1
  %c = icmp eq i16 %j1, 16
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  ret void
}

p11_const_base.ll.source:
; Constant near base 0xFFF0, unflagged: the address wraps at iteration 16
; in a well-defined execution, so nuw must not be added.
define void @wraps_const(i8 %v) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %j = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %j1, %loop ]
  %a = getelementptr i8, ptr inttoptr (i16 -16 to ptr), i16 %j
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %a, align 1
  %j1 = add nuw nsw i16 %j, 1
  %c = icmp eq i16 %j1, 64
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  ret void
}
; Constant base 0xFF00, 64 iterations: never wraps; a proof is legitimate.
define void @nowrap_const(i8 %v) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %j = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %j1, %loop ]
  %a = getelementptr i8, ptr inttoptr (i16 -256 to ptr), i16 %j
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %a, align 1
  %j1 = add nuw nsw i16 %j, 1
  %c = icmp eq i16 %j1, 64
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  ret void
}
; Base with a known range via a zext'd byte, unflagged: base <= 255, j < 64.
define void @range_base(i8 %b, i8 %v) {
entry:
  %bz = zext i8 %b to i16
  %bp = inttoptr i16 %bz to ptr
  br label %loop
loop:
  %j = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %j1, %loop ]
  %a = getelementptr i8, ptr %bp, i16 %j
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %a, align 1
  %j1 = add nuw nsw i16 %j, 1
  %c = icmp eq i16 %j1, 64
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  ret void
}

p12_misc.ll.source:
; Inbounds address escapes via a pointer compare as well as a store.
define i1 @escape_cmp(ptr %p, ptr %lim, i8 %v) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %i = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %i1, %loop ]
  %a = getelementptr inbounds i8, ptr %p, i16 %i
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %a, align 1
  %i1 = add nuw nsw i16 %i, 1
  %c = icmp eq i16 %i1, 64
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  %last = getelementptr inbounds i8, ptr %p, i16 %i
  %r = icmp ult ptr %last, %lim
  ret i1 %r
}
; Step 2 inbounds over i8 elements.
define void @step2(ptr %p, i8 %v) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %i = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %i1, %loop ]
  %a = getelementptr inbounds i8, ptr %p, i16 %i
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %a, align 1
  %i1 = add nuw nsw i16 %i, 2
  %c = icmp ult i16 %i1, 200
  br i1 %c, label %loop, label %exit
exit:
  ret void
}
; optnone function: skipLoop must suppress the pass.
define void @opt_none(ptr %p, i8 %v) noinline optnone {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %j = phi i8 [ 0, %entry ], [ %j1, %loop ]
  %a = getelementptr inbounds i8, ptr %p, i8 %j
  store volatile i8 %v, ptr %a, align 1
  %j1 = add nuw nsw i8 %j, 1
  %c = icmp eq i8 %j1, 64
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop
exit:
  ret void
}
